title: You can attend church your entire life…
paragraphs:
You can attend church your entire life…
and still never be born again.

Salvation isn’t about where you sit on Sunday.
It’s about whether Jesus changed your heart.

Many people know religion.
Few know Christ.
Going to church doesn't automatically mean you're saved.
A person can sit in a pew every Sunday and still never surrender to Jesus.
Some people attend church their whole life but never truly surrender to Christ.

Do you think church attendance means someone is saved?
Be honest.
